comments.message: Over 20. 22 runs. Bowler: Shivam Dube. England: 246/7(rr 12.30)

SIX! Shivam Dube to Jofra Archer. Half volley, outside off stump on the back foot driving, well timed in the air under control over deep extra cover for 6 runs. That's it! India win a thrilling contest and book their place in the Final. England chased with great intent, as Jacob Bethell scored a brilliant century to keep their hopes alive but unfortunately for him, his effort went in vain. Axar Patel's outstanding couple of catches and Jasprit Bumrah's crucial 18th over sealed the match for India. Hardik Pandya picked up two wickets, while the rest of the bowlers chipped in with some tight and defensive bowling. In the end, India's superior fielding proved to be the difference between the two sides. Sanju Samson is the Player of the Match for his excellent knock in the first innings.
